title: Feedback Control and Local Convexification of Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: Building on the feedback stabilization framework that we developed for McKean-Vlasov PDEs, we treat a class of entropy-regularized free energies $F = E + σ\mathrm{Ent}$ on the flat torus, with $E$ possibly nonconvex and nonlocal, and show that the resulting controlled system admits a gradient flow formulation in Wasserstein space. Specifically, we realize the Wasserstein Hessian at a target stationary measure $\barμ$ as a self-adjoint operator with compact resolvent and show that its negative is unitarily equivalent to the generator of the linearized dynamics.
